title: Demo Console tour: produce annotated screenshots for backup mode + standardized click path
creator: Soojin Lee
description:
Context
We need a reliable “backup mode” for Console portions of the sales demo and a consistent Console tour across SEs/AEs. Recent dry runs showed brittleness when dashboards are empty, UI labels shift, or the wrong project/time range is selected. This ticket produces a standardized click path and a set of annotated screenshots that match the talk track and deck.

Goals
1) Backup mode: a complete annotated screenshot set that can replace live Console navigation if anything breaks.
2) Standardized tour: consistent story beats + exact navigation path (“where to click, what to point out”) aligned to the 30-min run-of-show.
3) Reduce demo flakiness: screenshots must be captured from the demo tenant with synthetic data, with clear time ranges and stable UI states.

Non-goals
- Redesigning Console UI components.
- Creating a fully produced marketing video (separate request).

Audience
- Primary: Sales Engineering (Markus Klein + SE team)
- Secondary: AEs running light demos, PMM updating deck, Customer Success using backup materials

Deliverables
A) Annotated screenshots (PNG) + source file
- Source: Figma file containing all screenshots + annotation layers.
- Exports: PNGs for insertion into the demo deck + a PDF bundle for “backup mode” screen sharing.
- Two variants:
  - Standard (NA): USD pricing/cost examples, US region selected where relevant.
  - EMEA variant: copy callouts emphasizing data residency + EU region selected in filters where applicable.

B) Console tour click path (1-pager)
- A short, step-by-step guide mirroring the run-of-show:
  - What to open
  - Which nav items
  - Which filters (project, route, model, time range)
  - Exactly what to say/point at for each screen

C) Annotation style guide (lightweight)
- Callout rules so future updates are consistent:
  - Callout numbers (1–N) in order of narration
  - Blue = “click here”, Yellow = “call out / narrate”, Red = “risk / don’t show / internal only”
  - Avoid highlighting any secrets, key IDs, internal hostnames, or incident-only info

Required screens (must-have)
1) Console landing / Project selector
- Purpose: establish this is a production-grade ops surface, not a toy dashboard.
- Callouts: Org → Project, environment naming conventions, “demo tenant” guardrails.

2) Usage overview dashboard (tokens, cost, latency)
- Time range: “Last 24 hours” AND a pinned “Last 15 minutes” view to show freshness.
- Callouts: token-level breakdown concept; how dashboards stay populated via synthetic traffic.

3) Requests view (sample requests + response metadata)
- Callouts: request IDs, regions, model pin, streaming indicator, retries.

4) Cost breakdown view
- Callouts: per-route spend, prompt vs completion tokens, caching/batching levers.

5) Latency view
- Callouts: p50/p95, queue vs compute, effect of batching.

6) Errors view
- Callouts: error codes (synthetic), correlation to traces, “graceful degradation” narrative.

7) Traces detail (single request)
- Callouts: stages (auth, routing, inference, post-processing), where to debug.

8) Rollouts / routing policy view
- Callouts: canary/A-B, fallback to compatible model variants/regions, how pinning works for demo stability.
- Important: redact any internal-only policy knobs not in GA.

9) Audit logs (backup screenshot only)
- Callouts: who did what (synthetic users), retention controls and export.
- Rule: show only in enterprise/security module; avoid anything that looks like real customer activity.

Capture requirements
- Tenant: demo org only, seeded synthetic data only.
- Browser: Chrome, default zoom 100%.
- Resolution: 1440×900 (preferred) and ensure nothing important is below the fold.
- Theme: Light theme (matches deck); include a note if dark theme is needed.
- Filters must be explicit in the screenshot (project name visible; time range visible).
- Redaction: remove any email addresses that look real, API key UI, key IDs, or internal URLs.

File naming + storage
- Figma: “Demo Console Tour — Backup Screenshots (v1)”
- PNG exports naming: console-tour_v1_[screen#]_[screen-name]_[na|emea].png
- Shared location: Go-to-market Drive → Demo enablement → /backup-mode/console-tour/

Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Figma file delivered with all screenshots + annotations (NA + EMEA variants).
- [ ] Exported PNGs + compiled PDF uploaded to shared drive path above.
- [ ] 1-pager click path documented and reviewed by Markus Klein (SE).
- [ ] PMM sign-off (Soojin Lee) that screenshots align with talk track story beats.
- [ ] Security sanity check: no secrets, no real customer identifiers, no internal-only infra details.

Risks / maintenance plan
- Console UI changes can stale screenshots quickly. Mitigation:
  - Include “last verified” date on the 1-pager.
  - Add a mini checklist to re-capture top 3 screens monthly: Overview, Latency, Rollouts.
  - If Console empty states change, re-capture at next console release.

Stakeholders
- SE owner: Markus Klein (final usability review)
- PMM: Soojin Lee (messaging consistency)
- Console sponsor/eng: Dylan Brooks / Chloe Martin (ensure screens are stable enough)
- Docs: Elliot Price (publish internal enablement page links)

Links / references (internal)
- Demo run-of-show: “demo-script-run-of-show” (Drive)
- Demo talk track v1: Confluence → Sales enablement → Positioning and messaging
- Demo tenant reset + healthcheck runbook: Confluence → Eng Platform runbooks

Notes
If dashboards are empty during capture, coordinate with Eng Platform to run the synthetic traffic generator and wait for ingestion (target: <10 min). Screenshots must show non-empty graphs and at least one traceable request.
